$comment: Per-page information gain records the actual answer-to-decision/example-to-existing-asset-to-evidence/limit-to-next-step stack. `pages` retains the existing 40 proof-backed assets checked by tools/info-gain.mjs; this registry is not a competitive-uniqueness, ranking or score model. Existing `proof` strings must appear verbatim in page HTML. Optional `layers` document the live content stack and are not separately counted or scored; `layerNotes` may document useful in-page examples without adding an asset-coverage entry.

/kasutusjuhud/.asset: Töövoo aja illustratsiooni kalkulaator (tulemus on näide, mitte kokkuhoiulubadus)

/viitamine/.asset: Kõik avalikud mallid ja allikad ühes kohas

layers.answer: The Estonian scope guide screens whether the entity and its activity meet the applicable conditions; the result depends on the legal facts, not only the company name.
layers.decision_or_example: Use the four-question browser check, then record the entity, activity, relevant size/group facts and the answer in the memo.
layers.tool_or_download: Existing four-question browser check and memo DOCX.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The guide cites KüTS and RIA. The screen is an aid, not a legal opinion; verify current law and RIA instructions, especially special cases.
layers.next_step: Continue to /nis2/kontrollnimekiri/ for measures, /nis2/registreerimine/ for registration or /nis2/audit/ for evidence.

layers.answer: Article 21(2)(a)-(j) contains ten risk-management measures; logs are evidence for several measures, not an extra measure.
layers.decision_or_example: For continuity, test a restore and record elapsed time/RTO and data-loss boundary/RPO; the page labels practical examples and recommendations separately from legal duties.
layers.tool_or_download: Existing interactive ten-measure checklist with progress and print/PDF controls.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The page cites the legal measure text and labels recommendations/examples; a checked item is not a certification or proof that a control operates.
layers.next_step: Use /artiklid/varunduse-taastetest/ for the illustrative recovery plan or /nis2/audit/ for evidence collection.

/nis2/audit/.asset: Auditi tõendite register (Excel: rippmenüüd, tähtaja värv ja kokkuvõte)

layers.answer: NIS2 does not prescribe one certificate or audit form; a review should connect measures and management duties to evidence.
layers.decision_or_example: Define scope, criteria and method; record a finding with evidence, risk, owner, date and follow-up.
layers.tool_or_download: Existing Excel evidence register with measure rows, date fields, status/results and summary.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The page cites NIS2/KüTS and says Tehisabiline does not issue legal opinions, certificates or official compliance audits.
layers.next_step: Use /nis2/kontrollnimekiri/ for measure evidence or /kuberaudit/ and /pentestimine/ to scope technical work.

/nis2/toetus/.asset: EIS NIS2 toetuse tingimuste tabel (maht, määrad, tähtaeg; olek kontrollitud 27.10.2026)

layers.answer: A useful pentest report shows scope, method, repeatable evidence, impact, remediation and retest conditions.
layers.decision_or_example: The page walks through a fictional engagement with three synthetic findings and a retest; it is a format example, not a case study.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The page explicitly says all names, domains, targets and findings are fictional; none of the example results are customer outcomes.
layers.next_step: Compare report scope and evidence, then use /pentestimine/#tellimine to request a scoped offer.

layers.answer: A DORA register connects ICT contracts and providers to supported functions, criticality, data locations, subcontractors and exit risk.
layers.decision_or_example: Start from contracts, then assign the function and criticality before completing provider, location and exit evidence.
layers.tool_or_download: Existing browser-only CSV field/date/duplicate-ID check and internal working template.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The page cites DORA, ITS 2024/2956 and Finantsinspektsioon. The CSV is not the official submission format; check FI instructions and deadlines.
layers.next_step: Use /en/dora/register/ for the detailed ITS mapping or follow Finantsinspektsioon's official submission instructions.

/en/dora/register/.asset: Register of information template (CSV, English fields)

layers.answer: DORA Article 28(3) requires a maintained register; ITS 2024/2956 specifies the supervisory reporting format.
layers.decision_or_example: Collect by contractual arrangement and link the provider, function, criticality, data location, subcontractors and exit evidence across the official template structure.
layers.tool_or_download: Existing English working CSV with example rows to remove before use.
layers.evidence_and_limit: EBA and the Commission ITS are cited. The CSV is not the official ITS deliverable, a legal filing or proof of DORA compliance.
layers.next_step: Check the current Finantsinspektsioon instructions; use /en/dora/audit/ for broader evidence.

layers.answer: The AI Act uses risk categories and assigns obligations by system role and classification; not every AI system is high-risk.
layers.decision_or_example: Run the existing risk-class self-check, then verify whether the high-risk worksheet is relevant to the use case.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The page cites the AI Act and Commission material. Timelines have staged application and changed under later EU amendments; the self-check is not a legal determination or AI security test.
layers.next_step: Use /en/ai-act/high-risk/ only if the classification route points there.

layers.answer: For CRA technical documentation, the component list must be machine-readable and include at least first-level dependencies; the Regulation does not prescribe one exact format or require public release.
layers.decision_or_example: Choose a product/build inventory workflow and keep component versions, dependency information and vulnerability handling current.
layers.tool_or_download: Existing hand-filled CSV inventory worksheet and browser-side CSV structure check.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The page cites CRA Annex I Part II and distinguishes CRA product duties from NIS2 supply-chain risk management. The worksheet is not a machine-readable SBOM; the checker is not SPDX/CycloneDX validation, vulnerability scanning or proof of security.
layers.next_step: Use /cra/ to check product scope and reporting dates.

/iso-27001/auditeerimine/.asset: Siseauditi töövihik (Excel: auditiprogramm, nõuded 4–10, leidude register, parandusmeetmed)

/ai-act/korge-riskiga-susteemid/.asset: Art 6 / III lisa klassifikatsiooni tööleht koos art 9–15 tõenditega (XLSX)

layers.answer: CRA applies to in-scope products with digital elements; reporting duties started 2026-09-11 and the principal product requirements apply from 2027-12-11.
layers.decision_or_example: Answer the existing product/market questions, then distinguish the reporting timeline from the principal application date.
layers.tool_or_download: Existing browser-side scope self-check and reporting-deadline calculator.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The page cites Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 and European Commission guidance. The tools assist planning; they do not determine legal scope, issue a conformity decision or replace ENISA/CSIRT instructions.
layers.next_step: Use /sbom/ for component inventory boundaries or /en/cra/vulnerability-reporting/ for the English handling workflow.

/en/cra/vulnerability-reporting/.asset: Browser-only security.txt builder (RFC 9116 Contact/Expires validation, copy and download) plus a DOCX disclosure-policy outline and Annex I Part II evidence table (EN)

/en/nis2/.asset: NIS2 scoping, deadline, fine and registration calculators (EN)

/en/nis2/checklist/.asset: Interactive ten-measure checklist with the evidence and owner for each measure (EN)

/en/nis2/suppliers/.asset: NIS2 supplier questionnaire (CSV, 14 questions with evidence and risk columns)

layers.answer: NIS2 places the supply-chain risk-management duty on the in-scope entity; it does not create a separate supplier certificate or fixed mandatory questionnaire.
layers.decision_or_example: Assess direct suppliers proportionally, record the reason/evidence and use contract terms tied to the identified risk.
layers.tool_or_download: Existing 14-question supplier CSV with evidence, answer and risk columns.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The page cites NIS2 Articles 21(2)(d) and 21(3). Its questionnaire, suggested clause set and annual/event-driven cadence are practical aids, not prescribed text or a statutory fixed cycle.
layers.next_step: Use /en/nis2/checklist/ for the entity's ten measures; for a financial entity's register use /en/dora/register/.

/en/nis2/scope-assessment/.asset: Browser-only NIS2 scope assessment: sector, size and group test with a verdict, plus a decision worksheet CSV (EN)

layers.answer: NIS2 scope depends on entity type/activity, size and group treatment, plus special cases and national rules.
layers.decision_or_example: Work through the four legal steps, then document which entity, accounting period, group data and exception determine the result.
layers.tool_or_download: Existing browser-only yes/no assessment and decision worksheet CSV.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The page links the NIS2 Directive, KüTS and EU SME rules. The assessment is a screen, not a legal opinion; complex group facts and national special cases need authoritative review.
layers.next_step: Return to /en/nis2/ for duties, registration and the English checklist.

/en/nis2/vs-iso-27001/.asset: Article 21(2) to Annex A mapping CSV: controls, coverage, open gap and closing evidence per measure (EN)

/en/iso-27001/audit-checklist/.asset: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 internal audit checklist CSV: 63 controls with audit question, evidence to sample and gap note (EN)

/en/security-audit/checklist/.asset: Cybersecurity audit checklist CSV (74 rows across ten domains) plus a fill-in report template TXT (EN)

layers.answer: A cybersecurity audit tests whether controls exist and operate; a pentest asks whether a weakness can be exploited inside an agreed scope.
layers.decision_or_example: Choose the review from the decision needed, define systems and evidence period, then sample from a complete population rather than memory.
layers.tool_or_download: Existing 74-row, ten-domain checklist CSV plus plain-text report template.
layers.evidence_and_limit: The page calls the checklist a sampling plan, not a compliance certificate. A clean audit does not prove a secure system; a clean pentest does not prove controls operate.
layers.next_step: Use /en/security-audit/ for service scope, /en/iso-27001/audit-checklist/ for ISO-specific clauses or /en/nis2/audit/ for NIS2 evidence.

/en/pentest-report/.asset: Pentest report template TXT with CVSS/CWE finding fields and a scope worksheet CSV for rules of engagement (EN)

/en/tlpt/.asset: TLPT readiness checklist CSV mapped to the TIBER-EU phases and DORA Article 26 duties (EN)

/artiklid/varunduse-taastetest/.answer: RTO describes the time objective for restoring service; RPO describes the tolerable data-loss interval.
/artiklid/varunduse-taastetest/.decision_or_example: The existing 90-minute restore sequence is an illustrative test plan: restore one critical service, record elapsed time and the data point recovered, then compare the result with the organisation's own RTO/RPO.
/artiklid/varunduse-taastetest/.tool_or_download: No separate tool or download; the example and record prompts are in the article.
/artiklid/varunduse-taastetest/.evidence_and_limit: The article labels the scenario as an example to adapt. It is not a customer case, measured service result or legally required test cadence; NIS2 does not prescribe a universal RTO/RPO number.
/artiklid/varunduse-taastetest/.next_step: Use /nis2/kontrollnimekiri/ for the continuity measure and /artiklid/kuberriskide-register/ to record the risk and owner.
